title: File is 1471 lines (exceeds 1000-line maintainability guideline)
detail: At 1471 lines this file exceeds the maintainability threshold. Large files blur module responsibilities and slow code review. Fix: split into focused sub-modules.

title: 2× broad `except Exception` (BLE001) — lines 536, 1238
detail: 2 broad `except Exception` clauses across the file (first at line 536). Each one prevents callers from distinguishing retriable from fatal errors. Fix: catch specific exception types at each site; log + re-raise where the full cause must be preserved.

title: 4× broad `except Exception` (W0703) — lines 363, 375, 563, 867
detail: 4 broad `except Exception` clauses (first at line 363). Each swallows unexpected error types. Fix: catch specific exceptions at each site.

title: 2× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 274)
detail: At 2 location(s) (first at line 274), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: 3× unused argument (W0613) — e.g. `ex`, `ex`, `ex`
detail: 3 function arguments are never used within their function bodies. This often signals an interface mismatch or a method that should be `@staticmethod`. Fix: use the argument, or prefix with `_` if it's an intentionally unused interface slot.
